summary: The study explores the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of tin oxide thin films using tributyltin ethoxide and ozone on an OHT-terminated, SiO2-passivated Si(111) substrate. The process involves ligand exchange reactions, with the formation of carbonate and formate species during ozone pulses. The ALD process is self-limiting, and the films are carbon-free. The growth rate is 0.62 Å per cycle at 225 °C.
